feeds.title: KELOLAND
feeds.description: KELOLAND Media Group is the leading media company and most visited local website in the region. Get the Keloland News, Weather, and Sports for Sioux Falls, South Dakota, northwest Iowa, and southwest Minnesota. KELOLAND News has earned numerous state, regional, and national awards for excellence.

feeds.title: Mitchell Republic
feeds.description: The Daily Republic is your best local source for news, sports, obituaries, weather and much more from the Mitchell city in South Dakota.

feeds.title: DRGNews
feeds.description: Dakota Radio Group covers local, state and national news, sports and agriculture information. Also, get the obituaries, weather and sports news from South Dakota.

feeds.title: The New York Times » South Dakota
feeds.description: Get the local news and multimedia about South Dakota. Breaking news and multimedia about its people, politics and economy from The New York Times.

feeds.title: Black Hills Pioneer » South Dakota
feeds.description: The Black Hills Pioneer is the oldest paper in West River South Dakota and the only locally owned and operated newspaper in the territory. The Pioneer serves Spearfish, Lead, Deadwood, St. Onge and Whitewood in Lawrence County. Sturgis and Piedmont in Meade County and Belle Fourche, Newell, Vale and Nisland in Butte County.

feeds.title: Public News Service » South Dakota
feeds.description: The Public News Service provides reporting on a wide range of social, community, and environmental issues for mainstream and alternative media. It delivers breaking news and information on the latest top stories, weather, entertainment, politics and more from the state of South Dakota.

feeds.title: Capital Journal
feeds.description: Capital Journal is a dedicated group of newspaper professionals comprised of local journalists, press and production professionals, sales associates and news carriers, all committed to delivering a quality community newspaper to our readers each morning. We strive to provide the most up-to-date information available in the communities we serve. Capital Journal is a newspaper serving Pierre, Fort Pierre and surrounding communities in central South Dakota.

feeds.title: South Dakota Searchlight
feeds.description: South Dakota Searchlight provides free news and commentary on critical issues facing the state. Through our broad, well-researched in-depth article, we illuminate critical issues facing South Dakota, dissect the decisions made by state leaders, and explain the consequences of their policies and the role of politics on South Dakotans.

feeds.title: The Kingsbury Journal
feeds.description: Local and Independent, The Kingsbury Journal produces combined news coverage from The De Smet News & Lake Preston weeklies serving De Smet and surrounding South Dakota areas. Find fresh local news stories and opinion pieces on public issues and discourse.

feeds.title: Dakota Free Press
feeds.description: The Dakota Free Press, like its preceding incarnation the Madville Times, is about South Dakota politics. Cory Allen Heidelberger, editor and publisher, discusses and invites readers to discuss statewide and local issues. He occasionally turns to national and international issues, usually because of their impact on South Dakota, but sometimes just because he finds them darned interesting.

feeds.title: South Dakota News Watch
feeds.description: South Dakota News Watch is an independent, nonprofit organization reporting stories that shed light on the issues and concerns of all citizens. South Dakota News Watch journalists investigate important subjects, unravel complicated issues and tell stories that too often go untold-stories that make sense of our complex world.

feeds.title: South Dakota State News
feeds.description: The state news site is designed to provide you with the latest news and information from the State of South Dakota. This is a resource site intended for the media and citizens of South Dakota who are interested in the day to day operations of what is happening within state government.

feeds.title: Argus Leader
feeds.description: Argusleader.com is the home page of Sioux Falls South Dakota News providing you with in-depth and updated Sioux Falls local news stories. Argus Leader Media is a next-generation media company that empowers communities to connect, act and thrive.

feeds.title: KNBN-NewsCenter1
feeds.description: KNBN-NewsCenter1 is the Black Hills' area only locally-owned television station. Our mission is to keep our viewers safe and informed through accurate weather forecasts and the latest local and national news. Whether you are in Rapid City, Belle Fourche, Hot Springs or somewhere in between, we are here, bringing you news and information from just around the corner.
